en: Dependent on a state with a past object that is a root-cause, there arises a state with a non-past object that is not a root-cause, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are twenty-one; under object, nine ... pe ... under mutuality, seventeen ... pe ... under non-disappearance, twenty-one.

Dependent on a state with a past object that is not a root-cause, there arises a state with a non-future object that is not a root-cause, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are nine ... pe ... under non-disappearance, nine.
